```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load setup script
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("R", "load-data.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "kpis.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "communities.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "map.R"), echo = FALSE)

```

This **web-based report** serves as the central resource for monitoring Collaboratory’s key performance indicators (KPIs) and platform metrics. Designed for streamlined, data-driven decision-making, it allows the Secretariat to track progress against targets, identify trends, and extract actionable insights. All metrics are **updated weekly**, and all visualizations are structured for clarity and easy inclusion in presentations, reports, or strategic communications.

### Overview

```{=html}
<div class="stats-container">
<a href="pages/growth.html#no-member" style="text-decoration: none; color: inherit;">
  <div class="stats-box">
    <div class="stats-label">Number of Members</div>
    <div>`r total_users`</div>
  </div>
</a>
  
<a href="pages/communities.html#com-met" style="text-decoration: none; color: inherit;">
  <div class="stats-box">
    <div class="stats-label">Number of Networks and CoPs</div>
    <div>`r count_cop + count_network`</div>
  </div>
</a>
</div>
```

As of **`r fmt_date(snapshot_date, text = TRUE)`**, Collaboratory brings together **`r total_users` members** across **`r count_network` networks** and **`r count_cop` communities of practice**, connecting from **`r geo$n_countries` countries** and **`r institutions_label` institutions** worldwide.

Over the past month, **`r users_joined_last_month` new members** have joined the platform, contributing to ongoing growth and engagement.

### Key Performance Indicators

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) provide a standardized framework to monitor and evaluate progress. Indicators that meet current targets are shown in green. For each KPI, you can explore trends and detailed breakdowns in the subsequent report sections by clicking on the squares and hovering over elements to view definitions and targets. Some indicators are currently unreported, but they are included to highlight areas for future data collection.

